audience: developers who store embeddings and search them in Pinecone

useCases.title: Find vectors similar to a stored vector
useCases.text: Query an index with a vector or a stored id, with an optional metadata filter, then fetch the stored values of the matches.

useCases.title: Check index size and namespaces
useCases.text: List the indexes of the project, then count the vectors per namespace and check the index fullness.

useCases.title: Browse vector ids by prefix
useCases.text: List the vector ids of one namespace by id prefix, one page at a time, then fetch the values of a few of them.

useCases.title: Load embeddings into an index
useCases.text: Insert or replace up to 100 vectors per call, with their values and metadata.

useCases.title: Remove test vectors
useCases.text: Delete vectors that match a metadata filter, or clear one namespace. Deletion cannot be undone.
